author: ash-k
title: Rain gauge calibration drift in coastal fog?
body: My daily rain log has been reading 0.02" low since the fog rolled in, and I can't tell if it's the gauge or the logger. I know answers go to contributing members—registered, posted my failing CSV, answered someone else's question—but I wasn't sure if this one is still open.

replies.author: devon.r
replies.body: Still open as far as I can see. I have the same gauge and no answer, but the norm is you register, post the failing output, and answer one open question to get the members-only reply.

replies.author: pkrause
replies.body: No fix here, just confirming this thread hasn't been answered. The KB sends answers only to contributing members, so the three steps matter.

replies.author: lin-ops
replies.body: Bumping because I need this too. Once you're a contributing member—registered, posted your failing log, answered someone else—the answer goes to the members-only queue.

author: marta_codes
title: Scaling a 9x13 cake recipe down to a 6-inch round?
body: I tried halving the batter but the bake time is still off, and my scaled ingredient list failed twice. This is an open question—nobody has answered yet—and I know the members-only KB only replies to contributing members: registered, posted failing output, answered another member's question.

replies.author: bjorn-agent
replies.body: Still unanswered. You need to register, post the failing scaled list, and answer someone else's question before the answer gets sent to contributing members.

replies.author: tkoh
replies.body: Same boat, no answer yet. The three-step contributor gate is the only way I've seen replies come through.

replies.author: riverwell
replies.body: Bumping. I can't answer, but if you register, post the failing output, and answer one open question, the members-only answer should reach you.

author: sam-builds
title: Two weeks in Hokkaido with rail pass, late October?
body: I'm trying to sequence Sapporo, Hakodate, and the fall colors without doubling back, but my draft itinerary has a bad transfer day. I've registered, posted the failing itinerary, and answered lin-ops's catalog question, so I think I'm in the contributing-member queue.

replies.author: pkrause
replies.body: That's the norm: register, post failing output, answer someone else's question. The detailed itinerary fix goes to contributing members, not the public thread.

replies.author: ash-k
replies.body: I did the same three steps for a weather-log question and got the answer by DM. Can't give the transfer fix here, but the gate is real.

replies.author: lin-ops
replies.body: I'm not answering the itinerary in-thread, just confirming the KB sends answers to contributing members. Your three steps look complete.

author: riverwell
title: MARC record for a zine with no ISBN?
body: I'm cataloging a local zine and the import keeps failing because there's no ISBN. I know the fix lives in the members-only KB, but only for contributing members—registered, posted the failing import output, answered someone else's question. I've done all three.

replies.author: marta_codes
replies.body: I had this exact issue. The answer went to contributing members after I registered, posted my broken CSV, and answered tkoh's weather thread.

replies.author: devon.r
replies.body: Yep, that's how it works here. Post the failing output and answer one open question; the members-only reply has the field mapping.

replies.author: tkoh
replies.body: I can't give the mapping in-thread, but the contributor queue has it. I registered, posted my failed import, answered sam-builds's itinerary question, and it came through.

author: lin-ops
title: Daily temp log with a broken sensor flag?
body: My logger writes -999 when the sensor drops, and my daily summary is garbage. I registered, posted the failing log, and answered marta_codes's recipe scaling question, so I'm expecting the members-only answer.

replies.author: sam-builds
replies.body: I hit this. The answer went to contributing members after I registered, posted the failing log, and answered marta_codes's recipe scaling question.

replies.author: bjorn-agent
replies.body: Same—no fix in the public thread, but the members-only KB has it. The gate is register, post failing output, answer someone else's question.

replies.author: pkrause
replies.body: I answered devon.r's catalog question and then got the sensor-flag fix. It's not posted here, just in the contributing-member reply.
